title: Senior AI Strategist (Barcelona - German Speaker)
description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior AI Strategist (German Speaker), you are the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, helping the organization turn AI opportunities into successful, sustainable solutions. You will operate at the intersection of change management, stakeholder management, and AI delivery. Your role is to create alignment, bring structure to ambiguity, manage expectations, and ensure that teams and stakeholders move together towards the desired outcome.

You will work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Business stakeholders, IT, and senior leadership. While you won’t be expected to write code, you should be technically fluent enough to understand AI projects, challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs, and translate technical topics into clear business implications.

  • Drive change management initiatives related to the adoption of AI and new ways of working
  • Act as the key interface between technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and create alignment across different interests and priorities
  • Translate business needs into clear objectives, requirements, and actionable plans
  • Communicate complex technical topics in a clear, concise, and compelling way to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Facilitate discussions, manage expectations, and navigate challenging stakeholder situations
  • Identify resistance, risks, dependencies, and potential blockers early and proactively address them
  • Create structure and momentum in ambiguous or fast-paced environments
  • Coordinate delivery across cross-functional teams and ensure consistent progress towards agreed outcomes
  • Ensure that AI solutions are aligned with business needs, adoption requirements, and long-term value
  • Support teams and stakeholders throughout the transition from PoC to MVP and production

Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of expertise, experience, and skills including:

  • 6+ years in project/product management or change management + 4+ years working with AI/data/technology.
  • Solid understanding of AI, data, and the AI lifecycle; technically fluent enough to challenge decisions and understand trade-offs.
  • Experience driving technology, process, or organizational change and supporting adoption.
  • Strong ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders, navigate conflicting priorities, and build alignment.
  • Excellent communication skills; able to simplify complex topics and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience managing complex projects, timelines, risks, dependencies, and multiple stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English and German.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A competitive compensation package
  • A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
  • A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
  • A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
  • A position that enables you to have an impact on 1’000s of people, and the whole company's growth.
  • An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset

title: Lead Product Engineer (a)
description:
Über uns

MEONDI ist Unternehmenspartner für Digitalisierung und neue Arbeitsstrukturen. Wir navigieren unsere Kunden ganzheitlich durch Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse sowie agile Produktentwicklungen.
Mit MEONDI Frontier Services beschäftigen wir uns gezielt mit neuen Technologien und den Möglichkeiten, die daraus für Unternehmen entstehen. Wir beraten unsere Kunden dabei nicht nur, sondern entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen neue Konzepte, validieren diese früh und setzen daraus konkrete digitale Produkte und Lösungen um.
Unser Anspruch ist es, neue technologische Möglichkeiten früh zu verstehen, sinnvoll auf reale Probleme zu übertragen und daraus Lösungen zu entwickeln, die tatsächlich im Alltag funktionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, dass aus einer Produktidee ein belastbares Softwareprodukt wird?
Als Lead Product Engineer bist du ein zentraler Teil von MEONDI Frontier Services und gestaltest mit uns, wie wir neue Produkte technisch denken und umsetzen. Du bringst die technische Perspektive von Anfang an in wichtige Entscheidungen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Konsequenzen dieser Entscheidungen.
Dabei arbeitest du nicht in einer fertig definierten Rolle mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben. Du gestaltest die technische Seite unseres Produktgeschäfts aktiv mit, setzt Standards, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und baust selbst mit. Wenn wir mit unseren Produkten erfolgreich skalieren, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich mit.
Du verbindest fundiertes Software Engineering mit einem praktischen Verständnis für AI-Produkte und agentische Systeme. Du weißt, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt werden kann, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen, skalierbaren und wirtschaftlich tragfähigen Produkten zusammenkommt.

Zusätzliche Reisebereitschaft ist erforderlich und richtet sich nach dem jeweiligen Kundenprojekt. Je nach Projekt arbeitest du regelmäßig und möglicherweise mehrere Tage pro Woche vor Ort beim Kunden. Remote-Arbeit ist grundsätzlich möglich, sofern die jeweiligen Projekt- und Kundenanforderungen dies zulassen. Darüber hinaus solltest du bereit sein, regelmäßig bei MEONDI, insbesondere im Raum Stuttgart, präsent zu sein und an internen MEONDI-Events sowie Community-Treffen teilzunehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

Lead Product Engineer (a)


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Machbarkeit bewerten: Opportunities früh hinsichtlich Architektur, Risiken, Aufwand und Umsetzbarkeit einschätzen.
  • Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Produktspezifikationen in tragfähige technische Lösungen übersetzen und zentrale Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
  • Hands-on Software entwickeln: Produktive Software selbst bauen – vom Frontend über Backend und Datenhaltung bis zu Schnittstellen und Betrieb.
  • Produktionsreife sicherstellen: Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit, Security, DevOps, Observability, Wartbarkeit und Betrieb von Anfang an berücksichtigen.
  • Prototypen in Produkte überführen: Schnelle Validierungen technisch einordnen und daraus belastbare, langfristig tragfähige Systeme entwickeln.
  • AI-native Softwaresysteme entwickeln: Verstehen, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt wird, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen Produkten zusammenkommt.
  • AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung weiterentwickeln: Moderne Coding Agents und neue Engineering-Ansätze praktisch einsetzen, kritisch bewerten und sinnvoll in die Entwicklungsarbeit integrieren.
  • Engineering-Standards prägen: Architekturprinzipien, Tooling, Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards für Frontier Services mit aufbauen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast einen belastbaren Track Record mit produktiv eingesetzter Software.
  • Du hast bereits Verantwortung für Software übernommen und kennst die Anforderungen, die daraus im echten Betrieb entstehen.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in einem Produktumfeld oder einer vergleichbaren Situation mit echtem Skin in the Game für Qualität, Nutzen und Betrieb der Software.
  • Du kannst offene und unvollständig definierte Probleme selbstständig strukturieren, Lösungswege entwickeln und die richtigen nächsten Schritte bestimmen.
  • Du kannst dich nicht hinter großen Teams oder eng geschnittenen Tickets verstecken, sondern übernimmst Ownership für das Ergebnis.
  • Du besitzt ein starkes Full-Stack-Verständnis und kannst vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig entwickeln.
  • Du beherrschst die Grundlagen moderner Softwareentwicklung sicher – von Datenbanken, APIs und Architektur bis zu Testing, Cloud, Deployment, Security und Betrieb.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs, AI-Agenten und AI-basierten Anwendungen und verstehst, wie diese mit klassischer Softwarelogik zusammenspielen.
  • Du nutzt Coding Agents und AI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge produktiv und kannst deren Möglichkeiten und Grenzen realistisch einschätzen.
  • Du verbindest hohe Qualitätsansprüche mit Pragmatismus. Du vermeidest sowohl Overengineering als auch kurzfristige Lösungen, deren Konsequenzen später andere tragen müssen.
  • Du arbeitest gerne hands-on und validierst technische Entscheidungen im Code und in realen Systemen.
  • Englisch: sehr gute, verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse.
  • Deutsch: ein klarer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Kein bestimmter Abschluss erforderlich. Entscheidend sind technisches Urteilsvermögen, praktische Erfahrung und die Fähigkeit, produktive Software ganzheitlich zu entwickeln. Ein technisches Studium kann hilfreich sein, ist aber keine Voraussetzung.

Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung
Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unseres zukünftigen Produktgeschäfts. Du erhältst großen Einfluss auf Architektur, Toolchain, Engineering-Prinzipien und technische Ausrichtung.

Bei MEONDI erwartet dich eine Kultur, die von Offenheit, Transparenz und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe geprägt ist. Wir glauben an unternehmerisches Denken, Eigenverantwortung und daran, dass nachhaltige Lösungen im echten Dialog entstehen.

Professionelle Rahmenbedingungen und Benefits

title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
description:
Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
  • Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
  • Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
  • Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
  • Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
  • Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
  • Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
  • Actively contributing to internal discussions.
  • Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.


We are looking for

  • A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
  • As Project Officer: Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
  • As Project Manager: At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
  • A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. 
  • Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
  • Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
  • Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
  • Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. 
  • Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.
  • A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents.
  • Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel outside Europe. 

 We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job.


What we offer

  • An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform.
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home.
  • Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe.

The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.   

As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager

  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.

  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.

  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

 

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.



The team

We are a mission-driven team of 80 engineers based in London and the surrounding areas, united by the challenge of fixing healthcare communication. We are innovating for the NHS at a scale and depth that has never been done before, solving the real-world problems that stand between millions of patients and the care they need.

We are a highly cross-functional group where engineering, product, data, and security collaborate as true peers. We foster a low-ego, high-impact environment that values expertise and new ideas, maintaining the high standards required to build and scale a national healthcare communication platform. Within this ecosystem, our teams operate with high autonomy, owning everything from initial system design to long-term service stability.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of our Data Engineering, Product, and BI teams, expanding our data modelling and self-serve capabilities, and building the foundations that turn data from a support function into a strategic asset.

 

Challenges you'll solve…

  • You will own and evolve the presentation layer of our Snowflake data warehouse, modelling complex healthcare and health tech domains end-to-end using dbt.

  • You will design and build high-impact data models using advanced methodologies — translating real-world operational domains into scalable analytics blueprints that teams can trust.

  • You will partner closely with BI and Analytics teams to understand complex business requirements and deliver production-grade models that fuel actionable insights.

  • You will continuously improve data model performance and Snowflake warehouse design, prioritising compute efficiency, scalability, and a seamless experience for end users.

  • You will set, uphold, and scale standards for data quality, automated testing, and documentation within dbt — making our core data assets something the whole organisation can rely on.

  • You will champion self-serve analytics, training and empowering non-technical colleagues to confidently explore and leverage data through our BI tools.

  • You will mentor teammates, share advanced modelling knowledge, and contribute to a strong engineering culture through rigorous code reviews, sprint planning, and open collaboration.

  • You will support strategic data initiatives — collaborating across engineering teams to propose smart, scalable solutions and drive data infrastructure automation where it matters most.

You should apply if…

  • You have strong, proven experience as an Analytics Engineer within a modern data team, with advanced skills in SQL, Snowflake, and dbt (Core or Cloud). Experience with data ingestion tools like Fivetran or custom Python pipelines is a bonus.

  • You bring hands-on data modelling expertise, Dimensional Modelling, Star Schemas, Data Vault, or OBT, and know how to translate complex real-world domains into clean, scalable analytics blueprints.

  • You are comfortable working with cloud environments (specifically Azure), software engineering best practices like Git and CI/CD, and data governance frameworks including PII management and secure data access.

  • You have successfully driven self-serve analytics adoption across cross-functional teams, and can communicate complex technical architecture clearly to any stakeholder — from analysts to senior leadership.

  • You actively leverage AI tools to automate routine tasks and continuously explore ways to integrate AI into your workflows, improving quality and speed.

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Fix Healthcare Communication

title: Founding Data Analyst
description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of.

We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page.

As the first dedicated data hire, you'll set the standards and build the function out behind you as Dex grows. It's a chance to define how an AI-native company builds on its data from the ground up, in a market with a real dearth of well-built data foundations. We think there's a generational company to be built in this space, and we believe it's going to be Dex.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Core data modelling: Design and own the core data models that everything else depends on, making them clean, trusted and easy to build on.

  • Modelling at source: Work inside the product and engineering codebase to ensure data is captured and structured correctly from the start, before it ever reaches the warehouse.

  • Pipelines: Build and maintain the pipelines that connect our systems, so data flows through the business correctly and reliably.

  • Self-serve platform: Make the data platform genuinely self-serve, so product, growth, commercial and ops teams (and our agents) can answer their own questions without coming to you.

  • Agents as consumers: Treat agents as first-class consumers of the data layer, structuring data so they can do analytical work accurately and at scale.

  • Metrics that matter: Partner with the team on the metrics that matter, from acquisition and activation through to matching quality and commercial performance.

  • Answers, not just queries: Turn ambiguous business questions into the right data model, the right metric and a clear answer.

  • Standards: Set the standards for data quality, definitions and instrumentation across Dex.

 

What we’re looking for

  • You've built the data foundation for a consumer product or marketplace before, and you know what good looks like at scale.

  • You're an engineer and an analyst. You can model and pipe the data, and read what it's telling you about the business.

  • Comfortable reading existing code and finding your way through a codebase you didn't write. You can pick up how a system models and emits its data, and confidently make changes within it.

  • Fluent across a modern analytics stack (a cloud warehouse, a transformation layer, orchestration and BI), with views on what to use when. We're open to changing our current choices and want someone who can tell us where they're right and where they aren't.

  • Commercially and product minded. You care about the metric and the decision it drives, not just the query.

  • You think about the platform, not the one-off answer. You build things other people (and agents) can stand on.

  • Intelligent, ambitious, with strong judgement. A good person who's fun to work with and makes things happen without being asked.

    What We Offer

    • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

    • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

    • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

    • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

    • Gym membership & wellness benefits

    • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

    • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

    • MacBook Pro + team kit

    • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


    Interview process

    We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

    1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

    2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

    3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

    4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

    5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:
£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback.  If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy.

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 

What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production?

The role

The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business.

This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals — bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story.

You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding — clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients.

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win.

 

Key areas of responsibility

  • Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation
  • Define the pitch narrative, positioning and "red thread", ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout
  • Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver
  • Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses
  • Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content
  • Present and support client-facing sessions, including credentials presentations and pitch meetings
  • Lead and align senior stakeholders around a single, cohesive response
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP OpCos and partners, enabling effective collaboration across opportunities
  • Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated
  • Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities
  • Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing

 

  • Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to ensure WPP Production's positioning remains competitive
  • Identify opportunities to improve & drive innovation in how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Mentor and support New Business Managers and Executives, raising standards across the team

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • 7+ years' experience in a new business or client growth roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to shape clear, persuasive narratives from complex inputs
  • Strong strategic thinking, able to translate client challenges into structured, compelling solutions and responses
  • Proven experience leading complex pitch or proposal processes end-to-end
  • Confident communicator, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple high-value opportunities and large volumes of content simultaneously
  • Strong commercial capability, with experience shaping proposals and contributing to pricing approach, value framing and commercial models
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to identify opportunities and deliver outcomes
  • Collaborative in approach, able to bring together multiple stakeholders and disciplines into a single aligned response
  • Strong understanding of the advertising production landscape and broader marketing ecosystem
  • Curious and engaged, with an interest in innovation and the evolving content and production landscape
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with a good eye for structure and presentation

description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, one of the largest online food ordering and delivery platforms in the world. As part of this role, you'll join one of our Subscriptions teams in London, focused on the core proposition and working across our three subscription programmes - DashPass, Deliveroo Plus, and Wolt+. You'll work closely with engineering teams across the US and Europe, as part of the Global Subscription organisation, to build and evolve the shared subscriptions capabilities that power loyalty and membership experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI.

💡 Why Subscriptions? 

  • An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a small, focused team can ship.
  • Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale.
  • Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo,  DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experiences across three of the world's leading delivery platforms. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition and international complexity.
  • A small team that punches above its weight. We're a cross-functional team: Backend, Mobile, Web, Product, Design, and Data - all in the same room. No handoff theatre. You'll move fast, ship iteratively, and be around people who take craft seriously.

🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here

We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who:

  • Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR.
  • Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own?
  • Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team.
  • Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype.

If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in.

🔍 What We're Looking For Across all roles

  • Strong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first development. You use AI tools daily and have formed real opinions about how to get the most out of them.
  • Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do.
  • Collaborative instincts - the Subscriptions domain sits at the intersection of consumer mobile, web, backend, and data. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception.

🙌 About You 

  • You've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things running reliably in production. You have opinions about architecture but hold them lightly. You write tests. You read the alerts. You don't leave loose ends.
  • What sets you apart right now is that you're genuinely excited about where engineering is going. You've been experimenting with AI agents and agentic coding workflows - not because someone told you to, but because you couldn't help yourself. You think about how to redesign your development loop from first principles, not how to bolt AI onto the way you already work.
  • You communicate well, collaborate easily across disciplines, and care about the product as much as the code. You're the kind of engineer who asks "what's the best way to..." and then actually follows through.

🌍 Where You'll Work 

These roles are based in our tech hub in London.

description:

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in English. A second European language would be preferable.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA )

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

title: Expert Assurance | Courtage & IA @Panora (backed by Hexa)
description:
À propos de Panora

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si, mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

Pourquoi ce rôle existe

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur.

Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage.

Vos responsabilités

  • Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients.

  • La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir.

  • Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger.

  • Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision.

  • Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures

  • Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts

  • Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47

  • Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client

  • Vous êtes sincèrement curieux de ce que l'IA change pour notre secteur, enthousiaste à l'idée de le vivre de l'intérieur et d'y contribuer

  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et attachez plus d'importance au métier de l'assurance qu'au confort de la routine

  • Français courant ; l'anglais est un plus

Ce rôle est fait pour vous si

  • Vous vivez la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur — un point de vue rare dans le secteur

  • Vous êtes un membre fondateur d'une équipe qui construit l'OS IA pour les courtiers européens. Cela signifie une vraie ownership, un vrai impact, et une trajectoire qui évolue avec Panora.

title: Technical Writer
description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence.

In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes.

Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals

  • Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews

  • Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander)

  • Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment

  • Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions

  • Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update

Interface & System Specifications

  • Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering

  • Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients

  • Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences

  • Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version

  • Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines

Operational & Field Documentation

  • Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides

  • Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems

  • Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises

  • Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions

Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management

  • Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication

  • Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes

  • Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication

  • Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately

  • Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates

Client-Facing Delivery Documentation

  • Produce documentation packages for client deliverables: acceptance test procedures, delivery dossiers, and contractual documentation requirements

  • Support the preparation of responses to RFP documentation requirements and compliance matrices

  • Contribute to the development of training packages for institutional clients and partner integrators

  • Ensure client-facing documentation meets applicable defence documentation standards and contractual specifications

Candidate Profile - Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical writing — with a strong focus on product documentation, user manuals, or operational guides

  • Prior experience documenting hardware-software integrated systems — mandatory : you must be comfortable with complex, multi-component products

  • Background in defence, aerospace, robotics, deeptech, or dual-use is a strong plus — you understand the operational context in which your documentation will be used

  • Experience producing documentation for non-specialist end-users (operators, field technicians) as well as technical audiences (engineers, integrators)

  • Prior exposure to documentation lifecycle management and versioning in a product environment

title: Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer – Interceptor Drones
description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role
We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost

  • Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost

  • Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost

  • Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use

  • Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping

  • Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams

  • Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope

  • Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement

Candidate Profile:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work)

  • Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class

  • Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions
